tools.name: run_free_check
tools.description: Runs the free RenterCheck on one home to rent in England, as on rentercheck.co.uk: energy certificate, flood and planning designations, recorded crime nearby and sale history. Returns the findings, a link to the free report, and a link to Complete RenterCheck for the same home (rent comparison, owne

tools.name: find_addresses
tools.description: Lists the homes at a postcode in England, each with an address_id for run_free_check. Pass house_number_or_name to narrow a long list. Use it when the renter has given a postcode but not which home.

tools.name: check_rental_postcode
tools.description: Area facts for a postcode in England, when no particular home is given (for a specific address use run_free_check): the average private rent for the council (ONS), Local Housing Allowance rates, whether a council property licensing scheme covers the area, flood risk and the nearest stations.
